en.headline: Tang says talks to link private mall cameras to police SmartView network in final stage
en.dek: The security chief told a television programme that live monitoring would be risk-based and focused on crime hotspots, as the force aims for 60,000 cameras by 2028.
body: Secretary for Security Chris Tang said on Sunday that discussions with private shopping centres to connect their CCTV systems to the police SmartView network had entered the final stage.

Speaking on a television programme, Tang said live feeds would depend on the circumstances and would prioritise locations identified as crime hotspots. He added that existing signage under privacy rules already informed the public of recording, and further specific notices about police connection might not always be required.
The force has already linked cameras at the airport, railways and public housing estates. Tang also said fixed drone depots would expand from about 20 to around 200 to cover priority areas.

zh.headline: 鄧炳強：私人商場閉路電視接駁「銳眼」系統進入最後商討階段
zh.dek: 保安局局長在電視節目表示，實時接駁將視情況而定，優先犯罪黑點，目標2028年前安裝6萬支鏡頭。
body: 保安局局長鄧炳強周日表示，警方與私人商場商討將其閉路電視接駁至「銳眼」系統已進入最後階段，對象包括人流較多的商場。
鄧炳強在電視節目指出，是否實時接駁須視乎實際情況，若屬犯罪黑點則可能需要。他說根據私隱條例商場已有攝錄提示，未必一定需要另行告知已駁入警務系統。
目前「銳眼」已接駁機場、鐵路及公共屋邨。鄧炳強又透露，定點無人機庫將由約20個擴至約200個，以覆蓋重點地區。
